description:
Create an inbox placement test; returns the seed addresses the user must send their email to. Uses one of the account's inbox placement tests.
When to use: When the user wants to see whether their email lands in inbox or spam at major providers.
Parameters: name — unique, at most 64 characters; testType (optional) — 1 Email (needs senderEmail), 2 Unique ID, 3 Auto Alias (default); providerIds or seedIds (optional) — limit the seeds (see get_inbox_placement_providers); providers (optional) — [{"id": 1, "maxSeeds": 5}]. Results also go to the account's saved webhook, which is set in the ZeroBounce dashboard.
WRITE: Changes ZeroBounce account data (uploads, deletes, filters, tests, batch validation, warmup settings). Confirm with the user before calling.
CREDITS: Each successful call spends ZeroBounce account credits. Confirm with the user before calling unless they explicitly asked for validation, enrichment, or activity data.

name.description: Unique test name, at most 64 characters

providerIds.description: Use every active seed of these providers (ids from get_inbox_placement_providers)

maxSeeds.description: Seed cap for this provider, at least 1

senderEmail.description: The From address to match. Required when testType is 1.

testType.description: 1 = Email (requires senderEmail), 2 = Unique ID, 3 = Auto Alias
